name: Hasebe Masaaki
source:
The protagonist. Second-year student at Ayatsuji University.

Invited by his classmate, [url=/c156626]Haibara Ao[/url], he ends up taking a summer job as a servant at the mansion of the Hinomori family, a wealthy landowner outside the city. However, during his time there, he accidentally breaks an expensive item worth hundreds of millions of yen, saddling him with a huge bill.

However, the head of the family, [url=/c156624]Hinomori Kohaku[/url], proposes a peculiar game, which forces him to make every effort to have the debt canceled.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1343034]Getchu[/url]]
